hero.title: Premium Window Tint Films

benefits.title: Why Window Tinting?
benefits.subtitle: Experience the difference that professional window tinting makes

uvProtection.title: UV Protection
uvProtection.description: Block up to 99% of harmful ultraviolet rays, protecting your skin and your vehicle's interior from sun damage.

heatReduction.title: Heat Reduction
heatReduction.description: Significantly reduce cabin temperature by rejecting solar heat, keeping your car cool even in tropical climates.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: Enhance your personal privacy and security by limiting visibility into your vehicle from the outside.

glareReduction.title: Glare Reduction
glareReduction.description: Reduce blinding glare from the sun and oncoming headlights for safer, more comfortable driving.

interiorProtection.title: Interior Protection
interiorProtection.description: Prevent cracking, fading, and discoloration of your dashboard, seats, and upholstery caused by prolonged sun exposure.

energySaving.title: Energy Saving
energySaving.description: Lower your air conditioning usage and save fuel by keeping your car naturally cooler with heat-rejecting tint films.

standard.name: Standard Dyed
standard.description: Affordable dyed film providing good privacy and basic heat rejection. Ideal for budget-conscious customers.

ceramic.name: Ceramic
ceramic.description: Advanced nano-ceramic technology offering superior heat rejection without signal interference. Premium clarity and performance.

carbon.name: Carbon
carbon.description: Carbon-particle film delivering excellent heat rejection and a sleek matte finish. Will not fade over time.

adaptive.name: Adaptive Photochromic
adaptive.description: Intelligent tint that automatically adjusts its darkness based on sunlight intensity. The ultimate in smart window films.

crystalline.name: Crystalline
crystalline.description: Near-invisible film that rejects more heat than many darker films. Maximum clarity with maximum protection.

metallic.name: Metallic
metallic.description: Metal-particle film with a reflective finish, excellent heat rejection, and added shatter resistance.

service.shippingOnlyDesc: We ship the pre-cut tint films directly to you. Perfect if you have your own installer or prefer DIY.
service.installationDesc: Our certified technicians will install the tint films at a partner location near you.
